Loading Overlay

A semi-transparent overlay placed on top of content to indicate a loading state.

Overlay on Card

Place an overlay on a card to block interaction during loading.

Card Title

This card content is covered by a loading overlay. The content is still there but interaction is blocked.

HTML
<div class="zak-card zak-loading" style="position:relative">
    <div class="zak-card-body">
        <h3>Card Title</h3>
        <p>Card content...</p>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-overlay zak-overlay-active">
        <div class="zak-spinner"></div>
    </div>
</div>

Overlay on Table

Block table interaction during data fetching.

NameEmailRole
Alice Johnsonalice@example.comAdmin
Bob Smithbob@example.comEditor
Carol Daviscarol@example.comViewer
HTML
<div class="zak-loading" style="position:relative">
    <table class="zak-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Email</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>...</tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="zak-overlay zak-overlay-active">
        <div class="zak-spinner"></div>
    </div>
</div>

Overlay on Page

A full-page overlay for global loading states.

Loading page content...

HTML
<div class="zak-overlay zak-overlay-active">
    <div class="zak-overlay-content">
        <div class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-lg"></div>
        <p>Loading page content...</p>
    </div>
</div>

Overlay with Spinner

Default overlay using a spinner indicator.

HTML
<div class="zak-overlay zak-overlay-active">
    <div class="zak-overlay-content">
        <div class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-primary"></div>
    </div>
</div>

Overlay with Text

Display a text message alongside the loading indicator.

Saving changes...

HTML
<div class="zak-overlay zak-overlay-active">
    <div class="zak-overlay-content">
        <div class="zak-spinner"></div>
        <p>Saving changes...</p>
    </div>
</div>

Overlay with Progress Bar

Combine the overlay with a progress bar for determinate loading.

Uploading...

HTML
<div class="zak-overlay zak-overlay-active">
    <div class="zak-overlay-content" style="width:200px">
        <p>Uploading...</p>
        <div class="zak-progress">
            <div class="zak-progress-bar zak-progress-striped zak-progress-animated" style="width:65%"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

Toggle Demo

Click the buttons to toggle overlay states.

HTML
<script>
function toggleOverlay(id) {
    const container = document.getElementById(id);
    const overlay = container.querySelector('.zak-overlay');
    overlay.classList.toggle('zak-overlay-active');
}
</script>

CSS Variables

HTML
:root {
    --zak-overlay-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    --zak-overlay-z-index: 10;
    --zak-overlay-radius: inherit;
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
    --zak-overlay-bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}
